about_the_game:
Dive into the demo version of DREIFRAME, a challenging pixel-art metroidvania. Play as a Frame, a sword-wielding robot navigating a hostile, interconnected world filled with challenging mechanical foes.

Game Features

  • Explore a demo version of world of DreiFrame, filled with secrets, hidden paths, and collectibles.

  • Face challenging enemies in skillful, demanding confrontations.

  • Experience fluid, responsive controls designed for swift movement and intense battles.
